description: Projet Petrel© du réservoir géothermique du Dogger du bassin de Paris en région francilienne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Maxime Catinat. Ce projet a été élaboré pendant la thèse de doctorat de Maxime Catinat (2023) au laboratoire Géosciences (GEOPS) de l'Université Paris-Saclay. Le projet est présenté au format.pet (Petrel© version 2021). Coverage: Maxime Catinat. The portal shows the English title as "Petrel© project of the Dogger geothermal reservoir of the Paris Basin in the Paris region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Maxime Catinat. Its keywords include bdd, geothermie, modelisation, dogger, calcaires, reservoir. The listing shows 1 download or service links in RAR. The listing shows 2024-02-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
